about: The only record the public build reads. A piece is public when releasedAt (a Pacific/Honolulu date, YYYY-MM-DD) is today or earlier and hold is false. Empty releasedAt means unreleased. Ids follow the rn-selected-work form tfh-fw/<city>-day-<n>. postUrls maps platform to post URL. sourcePageUrl stays empty until the matching rn-selected-work /sources page exists.
